name: CSP Crawl Tier 3 — Apify WCC + Proxy

meta.description: Tier 3 site crawl: Apify Website Content Crawler with Apify residential proxy (~$0.004/page). Breaks Cloudflare and heavy bot detection. Probes homepage plus high-value page paths. includeGlobs target schema-relevant pages; excludeGlobs eliminate legal, HR, blog, docs, and auth pages. Part of M74 three-tier crawl architecture.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ startUrls: [ { url: $json.website }, { url: $json.base + '/pricing' }, { url: $json.base + '/features' }, { url: $json.base + '/integrations' }, { url: $json.base + '/about' } ], maxCrawlPages: $json.max_pages, maxCrawlDepth: 0, includeGlobs: [ { glob: '**/pricing*' }, { glob: '**/plans*' }, { glob: '**/product*' }, { glob: '**/platform*' }, { glob: '**/features*' }, { glob: '**/solutions*' }, { glob: '**/use-cases*' }, { glob: '**/use_cases*' }, { glob: '**/integrations*' }, { glob: '**/marketplace*' }, { glob: '**/apps*' }, { glob: '**/customers*' }, { glob: '**/case-studies*' }, { glob: '**/case_studies*' }, { glob: '**/success-stories*' }, { glob: '**/about*' }, { glob: '**/company*' }, { glob: '**/team*' }, { glob: '**/security*' }, { glob: '**/trust*' }, { glob: '**/compliance*' }, { glob: '**/contact*' }, { glob: '**/demo*' } ], excludeGlobs: [ { glob: '**/blog' }, { glob: '**/blog/**' }, { glob: '**/news/**' }, { glob: '**/press/**' }, { glob: '**/newsroom/**' }, { glob: '**/docs/**' }, { glob: '**/documentation/**' }, { glob: '**/help/**' }, { glob: '**/knowledge-base/**' }, { glob: '**/support/**' }, { glob: '**/changelog/**' }, { glob: '**/releases/**' }, { glob: '**/release-notes/**' }, { glob: '**/careers/**' }, { glob: '**/jobs/**' }, { glob: '**/hiring/**' }, { glob: '**/legal/**' }, { glob: '**/terms/**' }, { glob: '**/privacy/**' }, { glob: '**/cookie*' }, { glob: '**/gdpr/**' }, { glob: '**/dpa/**' }, { glob: '**/events/**' }, { glob: '**/webinars/**' }, { glob: '**/community/**' }, { glob: '**/forum/**' }, { glob: '**/status/**' }, { glob: '**/login*' }, { glob: '**/signup*' }, { glob: '**/register*' }, { glob: '**/app/**' }, { glob: '**/dashboard/**' }, { glob: '**/api/**' }, { glob: '**/developer/**' }, { glob: '**/tag/**' }, { glob: '**/category/**' }, { glob: '**/author/**' }, { glob: '**/archive/**' }, { glob: '**/search*' }, { glob: '**/*404*' }, { glob: '**/sitemap*' } ] }) }}

={{ ($json.pages || []).map(p => ({ vendor_website: $json.domain, page_url: p.url || '', title: p.title || '', clean_text: p.text || '', word_count: (p.text || '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length, page_depth: p.label ? 1 : 0, tier_used: 'tier3_wcc' })).filter(p => p.page_url) }}

={{ { crawl_tier3_result: { ok: $('Normalize Pages').first().json.ok, pipeline: 'csp-crawl-tier3-wcc', crawled_at: new Date().toISOString(), pages_fetched: $('Normalize Pages').first().json.pages_fetched, word_count: $('Normalize Pages').first().json.word_count, pricing_page_found: $('Normalize Pages').first().json.pricing_page_found, fields: { name: $('Normalize Pages').first().json.name } } } }}
